unseen_topics.q: 端到端校验 ECRC 是多少位？
unseen_topics.e: a Transaction Layer end-to-end 32-bit CRC (ECRC) can be applied to a TLP

unseen_topics.q: Switch 转发 TLP 时 ECRC 检查是必须的吗？
unseen_topics.e: Such a Switch can optionally check ECRC on TLPs that it forwards

unseen_topics.q: Data Poisoning 会直接引起 Data Link Layer Retry 吗？
unseen_topics.e: Error forwarding does not cause Data Link Layer Retry

unseen_topics.q: 没有 data payload 的 TLP 可以被毒化吗？
unseen_topics.e: Transmitters are only permitted to poison TLPs that include a data payload

unseen_topics.q: Transaction Layer 通过哪个 EP bit 表示 data poisoning？
unseen_topics.e: Poisoning of a TLP with a data payload in the Transaction Layer is indicated by a Set EP bit

unseen_topics.q: 一个 Port 支持多少个 Virtual Channels？
unseen_topics.e: PCI Express Ports can support 1 to 8 Virtual Channels

unseen_topics.q: TC0 到 VC0 的映射能改吗？
unseen_topics.e: The mapping of TC0 to VC0 is fixed

unseen_topics.q: TLP 自己是否携带 VC ID？
unseen_topics.e: while DLLPs contain VC ID information for Flow Control accounting, TLPs do not

unseen_topics.q: 虚拟通道的 Flow Control 是否相互独立？
unseen_topics.e: fully independent Flow Control between different VCs

unseen_topics.q: 原子操作 AtomicOp 返回 original value 还是更新后的值？
unseen_topics.e: potentially writes a new value back to the location, and returns the original value

unseen_topics.q: AtomicOps 属于 Posted 还是 Non-Posted？
unseen_topics.e: AtomicOps are Non-Posted Memory Transactions

unseen_topics.q: FetchAdd、Swap、CAS 是否使用同一个 type code？
unseen_topics.e: FetchAdd, Swap, and CAS each use a distinct type code

unseen_topics.q: Completer 如何从 AtomicOp Request 得到 operand size？
unseen_topics.e: The Completer infers the operand size from the Length field value and type code

unseen_topics.q: AtomicOp Completer 的 endian format 是否固定？
unseen_topics.e: The endian format used by AtomicOp Completers to read and write data at the target location is implementation specific

unseen_topics.q: Resizable BAR 是 mandatory 还是 optional capability？
unseen_topics.e: The Resizable BAR Extended Capability is an optional capability

unseen_topics.q: Resizable BAR hardware 必须支持的 resource size 范围是什么？
unseen_topics.e: Hardware must support at least one size in the range from 1 MB to 512 GB

unseen_topics.q: 不同 TC labels 的 transactions 之间需要 ordering 吗？
unseen_topics.e: There is no ordering requirement among transactions with different TC labels

unseen_topics.q: 收到 Reserved Completion Status value 时当成什么错误处理？
unseen_topics.e: Completions with a Reserved Completion Status value are treated as if the Completion Status was Unsupported Request (UR)

unseen_topics.q: Read 的 Completion Status 不是 Successful Completion 时还带数据吗？
unseen_topics.e: The Cpl (or CplLk) encoding is used instead of CplD (CplDLk)

unseen_topics.q: 规范定义如何确定 Poisoned TLP 的哪部分 data payload 实际损坏了吗？
unseen_topics.e: This document does not define any mechanism for determining which part or parts of the data payload of a Poisoned TLP are actually corrupt
